title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
text: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
text: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
text: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.

title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
text: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.

title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
text: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
text: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.

title: ElevenLabs’ new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
text: ElevenAI is a new meeting notetaker and dictation app aimed at teams and enterprises.

title: Israel’s VCs see opportunity for challengers in Nvidia’s turmoil
text: Given Nvidia’s stronghold on AI and its importance in Israel, many in the country's startup ecosystem are worried about the impact of his departure.

title: Jensen Huang didn’t show confidence in his successor, report says
text: Huang described Kress as a "deer in the headlights" during a meeting in summer.

title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
text: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.

title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
text: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke.

title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay
text: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses — but it's not free.

title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
text: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.

title: Jensen Huang was having a third affair, Reuters reports
text: Reuters is withholding the name of the new employee linked to Huang, but says she is an employee of Nvidia.

title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
text: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.

title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
text: Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's AI Mode is getting better at understanding complex queries, surfacing relevant links, and delivering richer visual responses.

title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
text: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.

title: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
text: Jensen Huang’s resignation raises questions about Nvidia’s commitment to open source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition, open-weight models, and advocacy against restrictions, as the company navigates a leadership transition.
